Table "public.schools"
               Column                |           Type           | Collation | Nullable |               Default                
 _id                                 | bigint                   |           | not null | nextval('schools__id_seq'::regclass)
 _created_at                         | timestamp with time zone |           | not null | now()
 _updated_at                         | timestamp with time zone |           | not null | now()
 _uuid                               | uuid                     |           | not null | gen_random_uuid()
 uuid_salt                           | uuid_salt                |           | not null | gen_uuid_salt()
 name                                | text                     |           | not null | 
 slug                                | school_slug              |           | not null | 
 oidc_issuer_url                     | text                     |           |          | 
 dashboard_oidc_client_id            | text                     |           |          | 
 dashboard_oidc_client_secret        | text                     |           |          | 
 app_oidc_client_id                  | text                     |           |          | 
 app_oidc_client_secret              | text                     |           |          | 
 moodle_base_url                     | text                     |           |          | 
 moodle_oauth2_client_id             | text                     |           |          | 
 moodle_oauth2_client_secret         | text                     |           |          | 
 moodle_plugin_shared_secret         | text                     |           |          | 
 vector_db_collection_name           | text                     |           | not null | 
 _active_classifier__id              | bigint                   |           |          | 
 auto_grant_data_protection_requests | boolean                  |           | not null | false
    TABLE "assignments" CONSTRAINT "assignments__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "classes" CONSTRAINT "classes__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "data_protection_requests" CONSTRAINT "data_protection_requests__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "departments" CONSTRAINT "departments__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "email_otps" CONSTRAINT "email_otps__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "oidc_auth_requests" CONSTRAINT "oidc_auth_requests__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "school_classifiers" CONSTRAINT "school_classifiers__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "school_training_states" CONSTRAINT "school_training_states__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id)
    TABLE "students" CONSTRAINT "students__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "teachers" CONSTRAINT "teachers__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "technical_term_video_ingests" CONSTRAINT "technical_term_video_ingests__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id)
    TABLE "technical_term_videos" CONSTRAINT "technical_term_videos__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id)
    TABLE "technical_terms" CONSTRAINT "technical_terms__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    trggr_schools__updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON schools FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update__updated_at()
    trggr_schools__vector_db_collection_name BEFORE INSERT ON schools FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_set_vector_db_collection_name()
                                              Table "public.teachers"
         Column          |           Type           | Collation | Nullable |                Default                
 _id                     | bigint                   |           | not null | nextval('teachers__id_seq'::regclass)
 _created_at             | timestamp with time zone |           | not null | now()
 _updated_at             | timestamp with time zone |           | not null | now()
 _uuid                   | salted_uuid              |           | not null | 
 _school__id             | bigint                   |           | not null | 
 email_address           | email_address            |           | not null | 
 role                    | teacher_role             |           | not null | 
 first_name              | text                     |           |          | 
 last_name               | text                     |           |          | 
 moodle_user_id          | text                     |           |          | 
 moodle_access_token     | text                     |           |          | 
 moodle_token_expires_at | timestamp with time zone |           |          | 
    TABLE "assignments" CONSTRAINT "assignments_submitted_by_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (submitted_by) REFERENCES teachers(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "data_protection_requests" CONSTRAINT "data_protection_requests__teacher__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_teacher__id) REFERENCES teachers(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "data_protection_requests" CONSTRAINT "data_protection_requests_granted_by__teacher__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (granted_by__teacher__id) REFERENCES teachers(_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
    TABLE "class_teacher_joins" CONSTRAINT "fk_class_teacher_joins_teacher_role" FOREIGN KEY (_teacher__id, _teacher__role) REFERENCES teachers(_id, role) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "department_teacher_joins" CONSTRAINT "fk_department_teacher_joins_teacher_role" FOREIGN KEY (_teacher__id, _teacher__role) REFERENCES teachers(_id, role) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "teacher_sessions" CONSTRAINT "teacher_sessions__teacher__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_teacher__id) REFERENCES teachers(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    TABLE "technical_terms" CONSTRAINT "technical_terms__creator_teacher__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_creator_teacher__id) REFERENCES teachers(_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
    trggr_teachers__salted_uuid BEFORE INSERT ON teachers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_set_salted_uuid()
    trggr_teachers__updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON teachers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update__updated_at()
                   Table "public.kysely_migration"

observation.command: cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U daz -d daz -c "\d schools" -c "\d teachers" -c "\d kysely_migration" 2>&1 | grep -E '^\s+\w' | head -60
